model_profile.mzi_unitary: U(theta, phi) = i exp(i theta/2) [[exp(i phi) sin(theta/2), exp(i phi) cos(theta/2)], [cos(theta/2), -sin(theta/2)]]
model_profile.theta_codebook: 2^bits levels k*pi/2^bits for k=0,...,2^bits-1 (pi excluded), matching the manuscript library grid
model_profile.quantization_gradient: straight-through estimator; every quantized forward pass uses hard codewords
model_profile.detector: per_mesh_intensity uses physical square-law detection after each mesh; per_mesh_coherent and coherent_stack are ablations
model_profile.shared_mask_meaning: 1 means a design-time trainable cross-task common 2x2 unit with no task delta; 0 means task-private phase deltas are enabled
model_profile.mpu_deployment_semantics: After training, shared_mask=1 units are fabricated/fixed as passive MPU transfer matrices using the learned common theta/phi. The training metric is multi-task accuracy only.

paired_mzi_voltage_error.scope: theta and phi phase shifters of each remaining active/private MZI; passive shared MPU matrices unchanged
paired_mzi_voltage_error.noise_model: independent zero-mean Gaussian equivalent phase offsets; resampled per forward batch; common hardware error within each batch

static_332_t90pct_codebook.evidence_label: measured-error simulation using the adopted matrix-error convention; not measured complex matrices
static_332_t90pct_codebook.transmission_definition: Frobenius norm squared / 2 for each deployed 2x2 codeword, equals 0.90; all singular values <= 1
static_332_t90pct_codebook.residual_model: static passive-constrained complex perturbation; precision calibrated after removing common attenuation
static_332_t90pct_codebook.forward_semantics: one fixed matrix per hard shared 3-bit codeword; the same table is held fixed during training and evaluation; shared gradients use the ideal 3-bit MZI STE path
static_332_t90pct_codebook.private_mzis: continuous task-specific phases, unchanged and lossless in this model
static_332_t90pct_codebook.phase_source: nominal theta/phi grid; no measured optical phases are available
static_332_t90pct_codebook.paired_voltage_noise: same final QAT checkpoint plus 10 mV RMS equivalent phase error on active MZIs; 5 test-noise draws; no additional training
